events.name: Shut up & Write: Broken Arrow
events.description:
Shut Up & Write hosts free in-person and online writing events for writers all over the world. Our goal is to ensure that every writer, regardless of genre or skill level, has access to the community, accountability, and resources they need to be successful in their personal writing goals. Our events use our proven formula: a few minutes of introductions, an hour of focused writing, and a final check-in to share the hour's progress.

What to Expect
RSVP and please arrive 10–15 minutes early to get settled at an in-person event. Our host will lead introductions and then everyone will write for a quiet, focused period of time.

Afterward, we’ll have an optional time to chat and get to know each other. Members often talk about their successes and challenges as writers. Our events are a safe space for writers to work on their craft. No one will read or critique your writing.
For more information about our events, visit https://shutupwrite.com.

Being Late is Okay: Just show up and get settled, then check in with me after the session. (I’ll be the person with the Shut Up & Write sign.) If you are on time, please be willing to make room for any friendly latecomers.

What Should I Bring?
Whatever you need to be able to write!
Bring earbuds/earplugs if you want to block the cafe’s ambient music or the occasional conversation by other patrons.

events.name: Silent Book Club at Rivendell Books and Baubles
events.description:
Join us for our Monthly Silent Book Club at Rivendell Books and Baubles!
Every third Thursday | 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM

Step into our cozy bookstore for an evening of literary discussion, peaceful reading, and bookish camaraderie. Whether you're a casual reader or a devoted bibliophile, you'll find your people here!

📚 Event Format:
6:00 - 6:30 PM: Social Hour • Arrive and get settled • Grab drinks and snacks from our coffee bar • Share what you're currently reading • Connect with fellow book lovers

6:30 - 7:30 PM: Quiet Reading Hour • Dedicated peaceful reading time • Bring your current read or browse our shelves • Enjoy the tranquil atmosphere among fellow readers

7:30 - 8:00 PM: Optional Social Time • Discuss what you read • Exchange book recommendations • Connect with your reading community • Wind down the evening at your own pace

What to expect: • A welcoming community of fellow readers • Comfortable seating for reading • Light refreshments available at our coffee bar • A peaceful, distraction-free environment • The magical ambiance of being surrounded by books
Bring whatever book you're currently reading - this isn't a traditional book club where everyone reads the same book. Instead, it's a dedicated time to read, share recommendations, and connect with other book lovers!

Mark your calendar for the third Thursday of every month and join our growing community of readers!

Location: Rivendell Books and Baubles 2034 W Houston St; Broken Arrow, OK 74012

Space is limited - we recommend arriving a few minutes early to get settled in.

Questions? Feel free to reach out to us!

events.name: PINT's Rockin' Auction Extravaganza
events.venue: Venue Shrine, 112 E 18th St S, Tulsa, OK 74119
events.description: Rock for Rescues, baby. Cobi Lalas plays the 70s through 90s sing-alongs you know by heart, there's a silent auction packed with art and oddities, and every dollar sends a homeless pup toward a real home. Tickets on StubWire.
events.website_description: Paws In Need Tulsa throws its Rockin' Auction Extravaganza at Venue Shrine, and it is the rare fundraiser that actually slaps. Local rockers Cobi Lalas open with the rock classics from the 70s, 80s, and 90s you will absolutely sing along to, then swing into their own quantum groove rock, all grunge grit and red-dirt soul. While the music plays you can wander a silent auction stacked with artwork, collectibles, experiences, and musical instruments, and every ticket and every winning bid funds PINT's transport program that drives homeless animals to rescue partners across the country. It runs 3 to 7pm, all heart, all good cause. Tickets are on StubWire. Best-time tip for the shy ones: come right at 3 while the auction tables are fresh and the room is still easy to work, scope your bids early, then settle in for the second set when the band gets weird and wonderful.
